# Cakes by Katie

> Bespoke wedding cakes, celebration cakes, and cupcakes handmade by Katie O'Callaghan in Thatcham, West Berkshire, UK (near Newbury and Reading).

## About

- [Home](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/): Overview and introduction to Cakes by Katie.
- [About](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/about): Meet Katie, the baker and decorator behind Cakes by Katie.
- [Pricing](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/pricing): Pricing guide for wedding cakes, celebration cakes, and cupcakes.
- [Flavours](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/flavours): Available cake flavours, including gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan options.
- [Testimonials](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/testimonials): Customer reviews and testimonials.
- [FAQs](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/faqs): Frequently asked questions.
- [Delivery](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/delivery): Delivery information and wedding venues served.
- [Awards](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/awards): News and awards received.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.cakesbykatie.co.uk/terms): Terms and conditions for placing an order.
